entities.name: Augustus Molade Akiwumi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Augustus Molade Akiwumi was a barrister and judge who became the second Speaker of the Parliament of Ghana from 1958 and 1960 and an inaugural Justice of the Supreme Court of Ghana between 1960 and 1961.
